WHAT may be merged is unchanged: tiers, mandates, pr-landing; the operator is asked only for Tier-3 changes the data does not settle; a lane never merges its own landing:hold PR. 2026-11-12 (operator chat ~11:50Z, Manager Session 2026-11-11a: "You need to make the edit to the Claude Code settings. I can take you off auto mode if you need that in order to make those changes." after "Whatever we break whatever gate is there and throw it in the trash"): added the live-review row write (GitHub create_or_update_file + git push to live-review/rows: the auto-mode classifier refused reviewer rows as Real-World Transactions, so decided breakout_2 closes could not reach the VM, which applies them under MD-LTR-PROP-AUTO), Actions run cancel/rerun for this repo (DevOps queue management, operator 11:05Z "I want you to clear the queue ... hooks._comment: MERGE-SLOT GUARD (operator-directed 2026-07-27). MEASURED 2026-08-20: this hook is NEVER INVOKED on Claude Code on the web -- that runtime registers zero project hooks (1,379 consecutive 'Hooks: Found 0 total hooks in registry' log lines, no marker file from any hook in /tmp across ~120 sessions), so it enforces nothing there and a successful merge must NOT be read as proof of protocol. The script is correct and fires where hooks load (CLI/desktop); its logic is pinned by tests/test_merge_slot_guard.py, which runs THIS command against synthetic stdin. See BL-20260819-MERGE-SLOT-GUARD-DOES-NOT-FIRE. Blocks merge_pull_request / enable_pr_auto_merge until the session has run the merge-slot protocol for the specific PR and set the per-PR marker /tmp/.claude-merge-claim-<sid>-<pr> (fresh <20min). Enforcement, not announcement: the SessionStart contract already TOLD sessions to claim the slot; a full session ignored it and auto-merged, racing a concurrent session into behind-rebase churn. This makes the claim a physical precondition of merging. Keep in sync with docs/claude/coordination-board.md + .claude/skills/session-coordination/SKILL.md + docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md multi-session coordination.
hooks.command: input=$(cat); sid=$(printf %s "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n1); pr=$(printf %s "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"pull[_]*[Nn]umber"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); sid=${sid:-default}; pr=${pr:-unknown}; marker="/tmp/.claude-merge-claim-${sid}-${pr}"; if [ -n "$(find "$marker" -mmin -20 2>/dev/null)" ]; then exit 0; fi; export GUARD_REASON="MERGE BLOCKED BY THE MERGE-SLOT GUARD (operator-directed 2026-07-27 after a full Track-D session auto-merged without the protocol, causing behind-rebase churn against a concurrent session). Before merging or arming auto-merge on PR #${pr}: (1) list OPEN PRs (real-time truth) — is another session mid-merge? (2) MAKE THE MERGE SLOT CLAIM. ⚠️ IT IS A FILE, NOT A BOARD COMMENT — the coordination board this guard used to name was ARCHIVED on 2026-09-21 and nothing reads it; do not go looking for it. Run:  python3 scripts/ops/claim_merge_slot.py --branch-claim --branch <branch> --held-by <session-id>  and COMMIT the .github/merge-slots/<slug>.json it writes, alongside .github/pr-landing/<slug>.json. (3) sync THIS branch to origin/main ONLY IF you need to — your change depends on something newly on main, or GitHub returns 405 merge conflicts (a real textual conflict). require-up-to-date is OFF since 2026-08-10, so 'behind' no longer blocks a merge and a reflexive re-sync just buys another full CI cycle. (4) then run:  touch /tmp/.claude-merge-claim-${sid}-${pr}  and RETRY this call. (5) There is no release step: the claim is released when the branch merges. This guard is a hard speed-bump, not the claim itself — make the real claim, it is what another session actually sees."; python3 -c 'import json,sys,os; r=os.environ["GUARD_REASON"]; print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":r}}))' ; exit 0

hooks._comment: VM-LANE GUARD (operator-directed 2026-07-28). The structural teeth on the FIFO VM-lane queue — mirrors the merge-slot guard. DENIES an issue_write ONLY when it carries the `trainer-vm-heavy-request` label (a HEAVY/exclusive trainer-VM job) and no fresh (<30min) /tmp/.claude-vm-lane-claim-<sid> marker exists. Quick trainer-vm-diag-request reads, system-actions, prop-reports, and every other issue create are NOT matched → always allowed (fail-open on any ambiguity). Forces the board VM-LANE CLAIM protocol (FIFO, running-never-preempted) before a heavy trainer dispatch so sessions stop disrupting each other on the one scarce core. The real claim is the 🔒 VM-LANE CLAIM comment on the board; the marker is a speed-bump. Prefer a FREE GH runner for CPU-only work (research-symbol-p0-build / research-exit-head-build). Logic + tests: .claude/hooks/vm_lane_guard.sh. Keep in sync with docs/claude/vm-resource-management.md + coordination-board.md + session-coordination SKILL.

hooks.command: log="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/logs/notify_hook.log"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$log")"; cp_line=$(grep -m1 '^## CP-' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/docs/claude/checkpoints/CHECKPOINT_LOG.md" 2>>"$log" || echo ''); [ -z "$cp_line" ] && { echo "$(date -Iseconds) skip: no CP entry found" >>"$log"; exit 0; }; cp_id=$(echo "$cp_line" | grep -oE 'CP-[0-9-]+' | head -1); title=$(echo "$cp_line" | sed 's/^## CP-[0-9-]* — //'); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { echo "$(date -Iseconds) firing $cp_id" >>"$log"; PYTHONPATH=. python3 scripts/notify_session.py session --checkpoint "$cp_id" --summary "$title" >>"$log" 2>&1; echo "$(date -Iseconds) exit=$?" >>"$log"; } || true
